verdict.rationale: The official Gemini CLI README directly claims the ability to generate new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches using its multimodal capabilities, which matches all three input types in the story. The support is a single bullet-point claim, with no detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the generated apps actually working. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the image/sketch/PDF-to-app workflow, independent or hands-on evidence that the generated apps are working.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Generate new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches using multimodal capabilities
